faqs.a: GTA 6 is scheduled to release on 19 November 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. It was originally expected in 2025 but was delayed twice, and Rockstar's parent company Take-Two has since reconfirmed the November 2026 date.

faqs.q: Will GTA 6 be available on PC at launch?
faqs.a: No. As of early November 2026, Rockstar has not announced a PC version of GTA 6 or a date for one, so the launch is on consoles only. Rockstar's earlier big releases, such as GTA 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2, came to PC some time after their console launch, which is why many players expect the same here.

faqs.q: Are the GTA 6 PC system requirements official?
faqs.a: No. Rockstar has not published official PC system requirements for GTA 6, so any specs you see online, including the estimates in this article, are informed guesses based on other demanding open-world games. The real requirements will only be known when Rockstar announces a PC version.

faqs.q: Should I upgrade my PC now for GTA 6?
faqs.a: It usually makes sense to wait. With no PC version or official requirements announced, upgrading now means guessing, and hardware options and prices will change before a PC release arrives. If you are upgrading for other games anyway, a balanced system with an SSD and a graphics card with plenty of video memory is a sensible choice.
